title: Burlington Freight Depot, Railroad Tracks - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing an industrial railroad scene dated July 1957 on the margin. In the foreground, concrete platform edging looks out onto sets of railroad tracks and cross ties. Beyond the tracks, a corrugated Burlington rail car sits along the siding near an older warehouse or depot building with 1950s automobiles parked outside under an overcast sky crisscrossed by overhead wires.
